title: Get in touch
description: What Darryl Patterson can do for you: AI and automation, user experience, engineering and leadership. Email, phone and location.
lead: Tell me about the problem, not the solution. If I can help, I will say how. If I cannot, I will say who might.
offersHeading: What I can do for you

offers.heading: AI and automation
offers.text: Finding the useful thing in your business that is worth building, then building it with AI coding agents: internal tools, integrations, the app nobody would fund. And honest advice on where AI does not belong.

offers.heading: User experience
offers.text: Research, information architecture, flows, wireframes and prototypes, design systems. Accessible by default, to WCAG 2.2 AA.

offers.heading: Engineering
offers.text: API and schema design, Node and Next, data pipelines and telemetry, cloud on GCP and AWS. Code that someone else can read in a year.

offers.heading: Leadership
offers.text: Building and mentoring teams, design and engineering process, source control and delivery. Thirty-five years of having seen it go both ways.
